name: Options Analytics Dashboard
description: Build a dashboard of implied volatility and Greeks from real option chains.

lessonNames.l6-tree-pricer: A binomial pricer for American options

lessonObjectives.l1-reading-a-chain: Read strikes, expiries, bids and asks in an option chain.
lessonObjectives.l2-cleaning-quotes: Filter out stale, crossed and zero-bid quotes.
lessonObjectives.l3-rates-dividends: Choose the interest rate and dividend inputs for each expiry.
lessonObjectives.l4-which-price: Decide between mid prices and the bid-ask range for calibration.
lessonObjectives.l5-bs-pricer: Implement and test a Black-Scholes pricer.
lessonObjectives.l6-tree-pricer: Reuse the binomial tree to price American options.
lessonObjectives.l7-mc-pricer: Implement a Monte Carlo pricer with a variance reduction trick.
lessonObjectives.l8-three-pricers: Compare the three pricers and explain where they differ.
lessonObjectives.l9-iv-solver: Implement a robust implied volatility solver.
lessonObjectives.l10-smile: Plot implied volatility across strikes and describe the smile.
lessonObjectives.l11-term-structure: Plot the term structure of implied volatility.
lessonObjectives.l12-surface: Build and plot a surface across strike and expiry.
lessonObjectives.l13-computing-greeks: Compute Greeks analytically and by bumping, and compare them.
lessonObjectives.l14-greek-profiles: Plot each Greek across strikes and times to expiry.
lessonObjectives.l15-arbitrage-checks: Test the surface for calendar and butterfly arbitrage.
lessonObjectives.l16-assembling: Assemble the dashboard and write its results note.
